topic: Decide which board game to play at game night

scenario.topic: Decide which board game to play at game night
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to you for game night: a quick, easy game, deep strategy, player interaction, or something light and fun?

options.name: Ticket to Ride
options.upside: Easy to learn with strategic route planning and moderate competition.
options.tradeoff: Can feel slow-paced for players wanting constant action.
options.concern: Less direct player conflict may reduce excitement for competitive players.
options.best_for: players who want a balanced strategic game with manageable complexity.

options.name: Codenames Duet
options.upside: Quick, cooperative word-guessing game that encourages teamwork and communication.
options.tradeoff: Limited competitive aspect may not satisfy those wanting head-to-head play.
options.concern: May feel too light or repetitive for players who prefer deeper mechanics.
options.best_for: players prioritizing fast, cooperative gameplay and easy setup.

options.name: Terraforming Mars
options.upside: Deep strategic gameplay with rich thematic immersion and meaningful decisions.
options.tradeoff: Longer playtime and complexity can be intimidating or exhausting.
options.concern: Setup and rules learning curve may slow down the start of the session.
options.best_for: players who want a deep, immersive strategy experience and have time to invest.

options.name: Sushi Go! Party
options.upside: Fast-paced, light drafting game with lots of player interaction and easy rules.
options.tradeoff: Less strategic depth might leave some players wanting more complexity.
options.concern: Randomness in card draws can frustrate players seeking control.
options.best_for: players looking for a quick, fun, and socially engaging game.

shared_context: There are exactly 3 participants for game night.
The game night is planned for about 2 hours in the evening.
All players enjoy a mix of competitive and cooperative games but have different preferences on complexity.

personas.name: Yuki
personas.background: Yuki recently started a new job with limited free evenings, so prefers games that balance engagement with reasonable time commitment.
personas.private_goal: To play a game that offers strategic depth without dragging on too long, allowing a satisfying but manageable game night.

personas.name: Lila
personas.background: Lila is introverted and values calm, cooperative activities that help her connect with others without overwhelming social pressure.
personas.private_goal: To enjoy a light, cooperative game that fosters teamwork and is easy to learn, so everyone feels included and relaxed.

personas.name: Hana
personas.background: Hana often hosts game nights and wants a game that keeps the group engaged but doesn’t require extensive setup or explanation.
personas.private_goal: To have a moderately strategic game that is immersive but not too long, balancing fun and ease of play for the group.
